title: FAQ's
section: **PAN applications submitted at TIN Facilitation Centres / PAN Centres**  |   | 1  | e-PAN Card will be dispatched at the email ID mentioned in the PAN application form  | 61  | 72  |   |  ###     **PAN applications submitted Online using physical mode (i.e. Physical documents forwarded to Protean e-Gov.)**  |   | 1  | e-PAN Card will be dispatched at the email ID mentioned in the PAN application form  | 61  | 72  |   |  ###     **PAN applications submitted Online through paperless modes (e-KYC & e-Sign / e-Sign scanned based / DSC scanned based):**  |   | 1  | e-PAN Card will be dispatched at the email ID mentioned in the PAN application form  | 56  | 66  |    [ What will I receive on submission of the PAN application form to a TIN-FC? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-07) You will receive an acknowledgment with a unique 15-digit acknowledgment number on submission of the PAN application form. [ How can I enquire about the status of my application? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-08)   1. You can inquire the status of your application by accessing Protean -TIN website at the "[Status track](https://tin.tin.proteantech.in/pantan/StatusTrack.html)" option and quoting your unique 15-digit acknowledgement number after three days of your application.   2. You can also check the status of your application through Automated Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system by calling 08069708080, or via Whatsapp at 8096078080 for real time time update.  [ How do I fill the PAN application form? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-09) You should fill the application form legibly in English capital letters and preferably with black ink. Read all the instructions before filling up PAN application form. [ Are two photographs compulsory for making an application for PAN? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-10) Yes. 'Individual' applicants should affix two recent colour photographs with white background (size 3.5 cm x 2.5 cm) in the space provided on the form. The photographs should not be stapled or clipped to the form. The applicant should sign across the photograph affixed on the left side of the form in such a manner that portion of signature is on photo as well as on form. The clarity of image on PAN card will depend on the quality and clarity of photograph affixed on the form. [ What documents should I submit along with the application form? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-11) You have to submit the following documents with the application form:   1. Proof of identity (POI)   2. Proof of address (POA)   3.
